audit_items.proof_trace: No runtime check validates kzg_commitments.len() <= max_blobs_per_block(epoch). The function verify_data_column_sidecar only checks kzg_commitments is non-empty and matches column/proofs length. Blob sidecars have analogous index validation (L1844) but data column sidecars lack commitment count validation.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker sends DataColumnSidecar via P2P with kzg_commitments.len()=100 (exceeding epoch limit of 6-9). All other fields valid (KZG proofs, inclusion proof, signature). Node accepts invalid sidecar violating protocol rules, causing state inconsistency and potential consensus divergence.
